[Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “不是适合孟子，而是让他觉得很伤心。” Formula: 虽然/…不但…，但是/而且…; or Situation + 让 + someone + feel + adjective Correct: “住在商店旁边不但不适合孟子成长，还让他觉得很伤心。” “不是……而是……” contrasts two noun-like choices or descriptions, but here you mean that this situation has two negative effects, so “不但……还……” is clearer.
